Risk Title: Inability to capitalise on the advancement of AI
KRI Description and Measurement: Tracks unfilled AI roles that slow AI delivery. Measured as open AI roles divided by approved AI headcount.

Risk Title: Inability to capitalise on the advancement of AI
KRI Description and Measurement: Signals loss of scarce AI skills before capability gaps appear. Measured as AI staff resignations in the last 12 months divided by average AI headcount.

Risk Title: Inability to capitalise on the advancement of AI
KRI Name: Average time to fill AI roles
KRI Description and Measurement: Shows how quickly the company can replace or add AI talent. Measured as average days from job approval to offer acceptance for AI roles.

Risk Title: Inability to capitalise on the advancement of AI
KRI Description and Measurement: Tracks whether existing staff keep pace with rapid AI change. Measured as AI staff completing planned upskilling hours divided by target hours.
Linked Cause or Effect: Pace of AI advancement too rapid to keep abreast

Risk Title: Inability to capitalise on the advancement of AI
KRI Name: Days since last AI landscape review
KRI Description and Measurement: Flags stale awareness of AI developments. Measured as days since the AI task force last issued a technology and competitor review.
Linked Cause or Effect: Pace of AI advancement too rapid to keep abreast

Risk Title: Inability to capitalise on the advancement of AI
KRI Description and Measurement: Tracks progress of embedding AI into core products. Measured as star products with at least one released AI feature divided by total star products.

Risk Title: Inability to capitalise on the advancement of AI
KRI Name: Quarterly customer churn to AI competitors
KRI Description and Measurement: Confirms business is already being lost. Measured as customers lost to AI enabled competitors divided by opening customers in the quarter.

Risk Title: Cyber attack on the crown jewel system
KRI Description and Measurement: Tracks exposure from unpatched software on the crown jewel system. Measured as critical patches overdue more than 14 days divided by critical patches released.

Risk Title: Cyber attack on the crown jewel system
KRI Description and Measurement: Shows how far firewall software lags the vendor supported release. Measured as firewall devices on an unsupported or end of life version divided by total firewall devices.

Risk Title: Cyber attack on the crown jewel system
KRI Name: MFA coverage of privileged and crown jewel access
KRI Description and Measurement: Measures protection against weak passwords. Measured as accounts with MFA enforced divided by total accounts with access.

Risk Title: Cyber attack on the crown jewel system
KRI Description and Measurement: Indicates staff susceptibility to credential theft. Measured as employees who click or submit credentials divided by employees tested in the latest simulation.

Risk Title: Cyber attack on the crown jewel system
KRI Name: Days since last crown jewel recovery test
KRI Description and Measurement: Checks readiness to limit business standstill. Measured as days since the last successful recovery test of the crown jewel system.
Linked Cause or Effect: Business standstill if the system is down (Preventive and Reductive Control health)

Risk Title: Cyber attack on the crown jewel system
KRI Name: Security incidents on crown jewel system
KRI Description and Measurement: Confirms attacks are succeeding. Measured as confirmed security incidents affecting the crown jewel system in the quarter.

Risk Title: Unfavourable FX Exchange Volatility
KRI Description and Measurement: Shows exposure left open to FX swings. Measured as unhedged forecast foreign currency revenue for the next 12 months divided by total forecast foreign currency revenue.

Risk Title: Unfavourable FX Exchange Volatility
KRI Description and Measurement: Gives early notice of unfavourable currency movement. Measured as the 30 day implied volatility of the main revenue currency pairs, in percent.

Risk Title: Unfavourable FX Exchange Volatility
KRI Description and Measurement: Tracks shortfall against the treasury hedging policy. Measured as policy hedge target percentage minus actual hedged percentage, in percentage points.

Risk Title: Unfavourable FX Exchange Volatility
KRI Description and Measurement: Signals interest rate shifts in major markets that tend to move exchange rates against the company. Measured as the absolute change over the last quarter in the interest rate gap between the home currency and the main revenue currency, in percentage points.
Linked Cause or Effect: Interest rate changes in major markets

Risk Title: Unfavourable FX Exchange Volatility
KRI Description and Measurement: Confirms FX impact on revenue. Measured as FX related revenue loss divided by budgeted revenue for the quarter.

Risk Title: Major fire at warehouse
KRI Description and Measurement: Tracks lapses in fire control discipline. Measured as warehouse fire safety checks overdue divided by checks scheduled.

Risk Title: Major fire at warehouse
KRI Description and Measurement: Shows staff readiness and attention to fire prevention. Measured as warehouse staff with current fire training divided by total warehouse staff.

Risk Title: Major fire at warehouse
KRI Name: Fire safety near miss and violation reports
KRI Description and Measurement: Captures negligent behaviour before a fire occurs. Measured as fire safety violations or near misses logged in the month, such as blocked exits or unattended hot work.

Risk Title: Major fire at warehouse
KRI Description and Measurement: Checks the loss reducing controls are still valid. Measured as days until the earliest expiry among the fire insurance policy and the BCP annual review.
